title: Hardware test & verification designer
description:
AtTOPIC(in the Netherlands) we work every day on high-tech innovations to make the world smarter, healthier, and better. Are you a highly driven and ambitious Hardware Test & Verification Designerwith a passion for designing, developing, and executing cutting-edge hardware testing, and ready to make a real impact on product quality and innovation?“There is a lot of flexibility to educate yourself.”Gijs van Esch I Hardware Engineer at TOPIC Embedded SystemsWhat will you do as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?
As a Hardware Test & Verification Designer you are responsible for designing, developing, and executing hardware testing and validation for complex embedded systems. Applies strong electronics knowledge (schematics, PCB design, signal behavior) to optimize performance and identify issues. Develops and maintains automated test scripts (Python required; Lab VIEW, Test Stand, or C/C++ preferred) and conducts HIL, reliability, and environmental testing.Your responsibilities as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer:
Design, develop, and execute hardware testing, validation, and verification activities for embedded systems, ensuring product reliability and compliance;
Apply a solid understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior to identify potential issues and optimize hardware performance;
Conduct and support HIL (Hardware-in-the-Loop) testing, as well as reliability and environmental qualification testing;
Collaborate closely with embedded software and firmware teams; a hands-on programming mindset is preferred;
Work in a structured, plan-oriented manner, maintaining high accuracy in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
Take a consultative approach, translating test results into clear and valuable recommendations for design improvements and product optimization;
Act as a technical consultant, capable of operating across different customer environments to ensure quality, robustness, and regulatory compliance of embedded hardware products.What do we offer you?
This will make you smarter:
Strategic projects in complex high-tech environments
Collaborate with other senior engineers and domain experts
Access to advanced training through our TOPIC Academy
Contribute to and lead tech events and knowledge sessionsThis will make you better:
Permanent contract
An all-in benefits package (€62.000 – €82.000 annually) including 13th month, mobility, pension, extra holidays
26 vacation days (option to buy extra), pension scheme, relocation supportThis will keep you healthy:
Good work-life balance, flexible hours, and hybrid working
Inspiring office with daily fresh fruit and a gym
Home office support for an inspiring work-from-home setup
Regular fun, social, and sports eventsWhat do you bring as a Hardware Test & Verification Designer?
A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Electronics, Computer Science, Embedded Systems, or a related technical field;
5+ years in hardware testing, validation, and verification;
Strong understanding of electronics, schematics, PCB design, and signal behavior;
Proficient in Python (required); experience with Lab VIEW, Test Stand, or C/C++ is a plus;
Familiarity with HIL testing, reliability testing, and environmental testing;
Affinity with embedded software and firmware; hands-on programming skills are preferred;
Plan-oriented and accurate, with strong skills in documentation, traceability, and reporting;
Able to interpret test results and translate them into actionable recommendations;
Comfortable acting as a technical consultant across various customer environments, ensuring the quality, reliability, and compliance of embedded hardware products;
A good command of English, and preferably Dutch language.Our organization
Since 1996 we have been developing (embedded) systems that are essential for products manufactured by renowned high-tech companies around the world. Our projects involve edge to cloud solutions; from PCB design and FPGA to low level embedded software and application software for UI, Web, Mobile and cloud. We are well known for our high level of knowledge and expertise and are proud to be a Premier Embedded Computing Partner of AMD; technology leader in the field of System-on-Chips and FPGAs.

Com um compromisso em seu desenvolvimento contínuo, você terá a oportunidade de aprender e crescer ao lado de alguns dos indivíduos mais talentosos do setor. Junte-se a nós e faça parte da criação de momentos inesquecíveis para nossos hóspedes, comunidades e uns aos outros.
Este é o seu momento. Inscreva-se hoje!Sobre nós
Um refúgio atemporal no coração de uma cidade movimentada. Um estilo de vida cosmopolita encontra o glamour do mundo antigo no Copacabana Palace. Com bares icônicos, restaurantes com estrela Michelin e um Spa estão todos esperando para serem descobertos dentro de suas paredes art déco.

Nós do Copacabana Palace, somos orgulhosos em fazer parte da LVMH e da coleção global de hotéis, trens e cruzeiros fluviais Belmond, todos criando experiências excepcionais em todo o mundo. Quando você se junta à nossa propriedade, você se torna parte de uma família global de hotéis ricos em história e destinos deslumbrantes, onde nossas(os) colaboradoras(es) estão no centro da experiência Belmond.

title: Diretor de saúde e segurança - operações da américa do sul/director, health & safety - south america
description:
O Diretor Regional de Saúde e Segurança (Operações da América do Sul) é responsável por liderar e supervisionar a função de saúde e segurança em todos as operações e projetos na América do Sul. Essa função garante a implementação efetiva da estratégia corporativa de saúde e segurança, impulsiona a melhoria contínua e promove uma cultura de segurança proativa alinhada com o compromisso da Pan American Silver em fazer "Segurança de forma Diferente". O Diretor Regional trabalha em estreita colaboração com a liderança do local, as equipes corporativas de saúde e segurança e as equipes de projeto para prevenir ferimentos graves e fatalidades, garantir a conformidade regulatória e promover as melhores práticas.

Reporta-se a: Vice-Presidente de Saúde e Segurança
Localização: Residência na América do Sul necessária.
Viagens: 30-40% anualmente para locais de operação e desenvolvimento, muitas vezes em grandes altitudes ou regiões remotas da América do Sul

Implementar e supervisionar a estratégia corporativa de saúde e segurança em todos os sites da América do Sul, com foco no gerenciamento de riscos críticos e prevenção de lesões graves e fatalidades: SIF (CRM, FIT/HOP, etc.)
Atuar como o principal elo de ligação entre a liderança das operações/projetos e o departamento corporativo de saúde e segurança.
Liderar, treinar e desenvolver equipes de saúde e segurança no local, garantindo a execução eficaz de programas de gerenciamento de segurança e planos de ação
Colaborar com a liderança do local e do projeto para identificar, planejar e executar projetos de melhoria técnica e metas anuais de saúde e segurança
Garantir que planos robustos de resposta a emergências e sistemas de preparação estejam em vigor e sejam testados regularmente
Monitorar o cumprimento da legislação, diretrizes e políticas de saúde e segurança da empresa; comunicar atualizações e garantir a implementação de novos requisitos
Incentivar a comunicação e o compartilhamento de lições aprendidas com incidentes e eventos de alto potencial em todos os locais
Promover uma cultura de segurança como um valor fundamental, envolvendo as partes interessadas em todos os níveis e servindo como um líder visível na região.
Apoiar o planejamento e a resposta à gestão de crises em nível regional

Experiência avançada em análise de risco, investigação de incidentes (i.e. ICAM) e implementaçãoda Gestão de Controles Críticos (i.e. FRM, CRM, etc)
Fortes habilidades de resolução de problemas, gerenciamento de projetos e organização

Deverá residir na América do Sul-The Director, Health & Safety – South American Operations is responsible for leading and overseeing the health and safety function across all mining sites and projects in our South American Operations region. This role ensures the effective implementation of corporate health and safety strategy, drives continuous improvement, and fosters a proactive safety culture aligned with Pan American Silver’s commitment to “Doing Safety Differently”. The Director collaborates closely with site leadership, Corporate health and safety (H&S), and project teams to prevent serious injuries and fatalities - SIFs, ensure regulatory compliance, and promote best practices.Reports to: Vice President, Health & Safety.
Location: Residence in South America is required.
Travel: 30–40% annually to operating and development sites, often at high altitudes or remote regions in South America.
Direct Reports: Site Health and Safety Leaders (dotted line/matrix org.).Major Responsibilities:
Implement and oversee the corporate health and safety strategy at all South American Operations sites, focusing on critical risk management and prevention of serious injuries and fatalities – SIFs (CRM, FIT/HOP, etc.).
Act as the primary liaison between site leadership and Corporate H&S.
Lead, coach, and develop site H&S teams, ensuring effective execution of safety management programs and action plans.
Collaborate with site and project leadership to identify, plan, and execute technical improvement projects and annual H&S objectives.
Ensure robust emergency response plans and preparedness systems are in place and regularly tested.
Monitor compliance with health and safety legislation, guidelines, and company policies; communicate updates and ensure implementation of new requirements.
Foster communication and sharing of lessons learned from incidents and high-potential events across sites.
Promote a culture of safety as a core value, engaging stakeholders at all levels and serving as a visible leader in the region.
Support crisis management planning and response at the regional level.
Prepare and present safety performance reports, metrics, and recommendations to regional and corporate leadership, including monthly and quarterly reports.Qualifications:
10+ years of experience in health and safety leadership roles within the mining industry, including site operations in South America.
Proven experience implementing Safety Management Systems and ensuring compliance with international and local health and safety regulations.
Advanced expertise in risk analysis, incident investigation (e.g., ICAM) and implementation of Critical Control Management (e.g., FRM, CRM, etc.).
Strong problem-solving, project management, and organizational skills.
Bachelor’s Degree in Occupational Health & Safety, Engineering, or related discipline (e.g., Industrial Safety, Environmental Science, Mining Engineering, Geoscience, Social Science).
Master’s Degree or relevant postgraduate education is preferred.
Fluency in Spanish and English required, Portuguese proficiency is an asset.Key Competencies
Experience in multicultural environments; current or previous experience working in Latin American countries is required.
Proficiency in creating compelling materials for internal and external stakeholders.
Inspirational leadership and ability to motivate cross-functional teams.
Strategic mindset focused on continuous improvement and operational excellence.
Effective communication and presentation skills, able to engage with site teams and senior management.
Ability to translate broad safety themes into actionable regional plans.Other Requirements
Willingness and ability to travel to operations and development sites, often at high altitudes and/or in remote regions of South America.
Must reside in South America.

title: Analista contábil júnior
description:
ALLOSé uma marca com uma forte herança. São cerca de 50 anos de experiência, transformando o mercado no Brasil. Em 2019, a fusão entre a Aliansce e a Sonae Sierra deu origem à Aliansce Sonae, tornando-se líder na administração de shoppings no Brasil, com 32 empreendimentos. title: Especialista de prompts
description:
Missão do cargo O Especialista de Prompts atua como o arquiteto das interações entre pessoas e agentes de Inteligência Artificial, sendo responsável por traduzir necessidades humanas em comandos estruturados, claros e seguros. Seu objetivo é maximizar a precisão, a eficiência e a confiabilidade das respostas geradas pelos modelos de linguagem.
Esse profissional é o ponto de conexão entre o conhecimento do negócio e as capacidades dos modelos de IA, assegurando que as soluções corporativas entreguem resultados consistentes, éticos e mensuráveis para o desempenho das áreas.
Principais responsabilidades Projetar, testar e otimizar prompts para modelos de linguagem (LLMs), aplicando técnicas avançadas como few-shot prompting , chain-of-thought e role-based prompting ; Desenvolver frameworks e templates reutilizáveis por área de negócio, criando bibliotecas internas de prompts com versionamento e controle de qualidade;
Definir e acompanhar métricas de qualidade de resposta, incluindo precisão, coerência e tempo de execução, além de realizar tuning de contexto com uso de embeddings, RAG e feedback humano; Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança, confidencialidade e ética, assegurando aderência à LGPD e aos padrões de governança de IA;
Elaborar e manter documentação técnica, diretrizes e boas práticas de engenharia de prompts corporativos;
Integrar soluções de prompting com fluxos e pipelines de IA corporativa, em colaboração com cientistas de dados e engenheiros de machine learning;
Aplicar princípios de vibecoding para calibrar tom, estilo e empatia nas respostas dos agentes de IA, garantindo consistência com a identidade verbal da empresa; Conduzir experimentos e testes A/B de prompts, utilizando metodologias de avaliação e monitoramento de performance;
Automatizar processos de geração, teste e avaliação de prompts por meio de Python, JSON Schema e pipelines de CI/CD;
Promover treinamentos e ações de evangelização interna sobre boas práticas de IA generativa;
Comunicar resultados e ganhos de produtividade, traduzindo dados técnicos em informações estratégicas e executivas.
Formação e experiência desejadas
Graduação em Engenharias, Linguística Computacional ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em engenharia de prompts, processamento de linguagem natural (NLP) ou aplicações de IA generativa;
Inglês intermediário.
Conhecimentos técnicos Plataformas e bibliotecas: Lang Chain, Tess, Prompt Layer, Llama Index, Hugging Face Transformers, Open AI API, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini API; Linguagens e ferramentas: Python, JSON Schema, Regex, Git, VS Code, Notion e Jupyter; Técnicas de otimização: Few-shot prompting , chain-of-thought , function calling , embeddings e RAG ( Retrieval-Augmented Generation ); Métricas e testes: BLEU, ROUGE, factual consistency , toxicity filters , RLHF e testes A/B;
Governança e conformidade: versionamento, anonimização de dados, logs auditáveis, filtros de segurança e aderência à LGPD.
Perfil profissional
Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico e criativo, forte capacidade de comunicação escrita e abstração semântica, aliado a pensamento técnico e visão de negócio.
É essencial ter curiosidade, atenção a detalhes e compromisso com o uso ético e responsável da Inteligência Artificial no ambiente corporativo.
Venha fazer parte de uma equipe que está moldando o futuro das interações entre pessoas e Inteligência Artificial.

title: Especialista de prompts
description:
Missão do cargoO Especialista de Prompts atua como o arquiteto das interações entre pessoas e agentes de Inteligência Artificial, sendo responsável por traduzir necessidades humanas em comandos estruturados, claros e seguros. Seu objetivo é maximizar a precisão, a eficiência e a confiabilidade das respostas geradas pelos modelos de linguagem.
Esse profissional é o ponto de conexão entre o conhecimento do negócio e as capacidades dos modelos de IA, assegurando que as soluções corporativas entreguem resultados consistentes, éticos e mensuráveis para o desempenho das áreas.Principais responsabilidades
Projetar, testar e otimizar prompts para modelos de linguagem (LLMs), aplicando técnicas avançadas comofew-shot prompting,chain-of-thoughterole-based prompting;
Desenvolver frameworks e templates reutilizáveis por área de negócio, criando bibliotecas internas de prompts com versionamento e controle de qualidade;
Definir e acompanhar métricas de qualidade de resposta, incluindo precisão, coerência e tempo de execução, além de realizartuningde contexto com uso de embeddings, RAG e feedback humano;
Garantir conformidade com políticas de segurança, confidencialidade e ética, assegurando aderência à LGPD e aos padrões de governança de IA;
Elaborar e manter documentação técnica, diretrizes e boas práticas de engenharia de prompts corporativos;
Integrar soluções de prompting com fluxos e pipelines de IA corporativa, em colaboração com cientistas de dados e engenheiros de machine learning;
Aplicar princípios devibecodingpara calibrar tom, estilo e empatia nas respostas dos agentes de IA, garantindo consistência com a identidade verbal da empresa;
Conduzir experimentos e testes A/B de prompts, utilizando metodologias de avaliação e monitoramento de performance;
Automatizar processos de geração, teste e avaliação de prompts por meio de Python, JSON Schema e pipelines de CI/CD;
Promover treinamentos e ações de evangelização interna sobre boas práticas de IA generativa;
Comunicar resultados e ganhos de produtividade, traduzindo dados técnicos em informações estratégicas e executivas.Formação e experiência desejadas
Graduação em Engenharias, Linguística Computacional ou áreas correlatas;
Experiência de 2 a 3 anos em engenharia de prompts, processamento de linguagem natural (NLP) ou aplicações de IA generativa;
Inglês intermediário.Conhecimentos técnicos
Plataformas e bibliotecas:Lang Chain, Tess, Prompt Layer, Llama Index, Hugging Face Transformers, Open AI API, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini API;
Linguagens e ferramentas:Python, JSON Schema, Regex, Git, VS Code, Notion e Jupyter;
Técnicas de otimização:Few-shot prompting,chain-of-thought,function calling, embeddings e RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation);
Métricas e testes:BLEU, ROUGE,factual consistency,toxicity filters,RLHFe testes A/B;
Governança e conformidade:versionamento, anonimização de dados, logs auditáveis, filtros de segurança e aderência à LGPD.Perfil profissional
Buscamos um(a) profissional com perfil analítico e criativo, forte capacidade de comunicação escrita e abstração semântica, aliado a pensamento técnico e visão de negócio.
É essencial ter curiosidade, atenção a detalhes e compromisso com o uso ético e responsável da Inteligência Artificial no ambiente corporativo.

description:

Birthday day off– Enjoy an extra day off during your birthday week to celebrate in style with friends and family!About the project:As aSenior Dev Sec Ops, you will bring a proven track record in designing complex, integrated security solutions, deep expertise across major cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP), and a strong understanding of modern security concepts like CNAPP, Zero Trust, and Dev Sec Ops.How you'll contribute✅ Propose and drive best practices to optimize cloud presence, performance, and security.
✅ Implement infrastructure and cloud solutions including computing, networking, routing, and security.

✅ Produce solution design documents and solicit agreement from stakeholders.

✅ Prefer to work on agile software development projects with globally distributed teams.This would make you the ideal candidate✨ Bachelor's Degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.
✨ 8+ Years of experience working in the industry.
✨ 3+ Years of experience working in Dev Sec Ops roles.
✨ A strong track record in automating and optimizing development and release pipelines.

✨ Hands-on experience with Kubernetes, containerization technologies, and Linux system administration.
✨ Proficiency with AWS services such as RDS, EKS, S3, IAM, and Route53 OR Azure equivalent.
✨ Familiarity with Infrastructure as Code tools like Terraform and Helm.
✨ A good understanding of microservices architecture.
✨ Strong knowledge of Linux/Unix systems and scripting (e.g., Bash, Python).
✨ Strong time management abilities and the capacity to prioritize tasks effectively in changing environments.
✨ A solid grasp of the Shift Left philosophy and the ability to mentor teams on secure development practices.
✨ Experience with agentless cloud-native security platforms like Wiz is considered a significant advantage.
✨ Advanced English Level is required for this role, as you will work with US clients. Effective communication in English is essential to deliver the best solutions to our clients and expand your horizons.What to expect from our hiring process1. Let’s chat about your experience!
2. Impress our recruiters, and you’ll move on to a technical interview with our top developers.
3. Nail that, and you’ll meet our client - your final step to joining our amazing team!At Nearsure, we’re dedicated to solving complex business challenges through cutting-edge technology and we believe in the power of tailored solutions. Whether you are passionate about transforming businesses with Generative AI, building innovative software products, or implementing comprehensive enterprise platform solutions, we invite you to be part of our dynamic team!We would love to hear from you if you are eager to make an impact and join a collaborative team that values creativity and expertise.Let’s work together to shape the future of technology!Apply now!

Buscamos uma pessoa analítica, curiosa e com muito gás para aprender e se desafiar. Alguém que goste de mergulhar em dados, entender o comportamento do consumidor e transformar análises em estratégias reais para impulsionar o produto e a venda das coleções.

Gestão do calendário de desenvolvimento da marca, garantindo o cumprimento dos prazos e marcos de cada coleção;
Criação da estratégia de mix de produto, definindo proporções, volumes, categorias e faixas de preço em linha com os objetivos da coleção;

Elaboração de planos de ação e estratégias comerciais para alavancar a performance da coleção junto às equipes de Varejo, Atacado e Marketing;
Colaboração próxima com times de Estilo, Compras, Merchandising e Comercial para garantir visão integrada do negócio.Requisitos e competências
Perfil analítico, organizado e proativo;
Capacidade analítica de conectar dados, mercado e marca para gerar recomendações assertivas;
Boa comunicação e espírito colaborativo;
Vontade genuína de aprender e crescer em um ambiente dinâmico;
Desejável: conhecimentos em SQL, Excel avançado e Power BI.

description:

= Executar limpeza concorrente nos setores conforme a rotina diária, de acordo com procedimento estabelecido, para

– Organizar o DML (depósito de material limpo) e o material de limpeza, carinho funcional e/ou balaio, de acordo com a

padronização estabelecida;

– Entregar o material (carrinho funcional e balaio) e DML, organizados, conforme protocolo estabelecido no POP

(procedimento operacional padrão) para o próximo colaborador pessoa que assumirá o plantão, visando à continuidade da

qualidade do serviço prestado;

– Realizar a diluição de produtos químicos de limpeza corretamente, seguindo as recomendações de segurança do trabalho,

bem como também as orientações fornecidas pelo fabricante do(s) produto(s), FISPQs e treinamentos aplicados.

– Seguir os cronogramas preestabelecido, diário, semanal e mensal;

– Executar atividades afins, de acordo com as suas competências, mediante solicitação do superior hierárquico.

title: Vigia
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Realiza rondas periódicas nas áreas internas e externas da empresa, prevenindo furtos, vandalismos e outras irregularidades. Controla o acesso de pessoas, veículos e mercadorias, verificando documentos e autorizações, impedindo a entrada de não autorizados. Registra dados de entrada/saída e elabora relatórios detalhados sobre ocorrências, informando superiores sobre qualquer anormalidade ou risco.

Identifica e age preventivamente diante de riscos de acidentes ou situações que comprometam a segurança. Em emergências (como incêndios, invasões ou acidentes), aciona os serviços competentes e atua para minimizar danos, podendo também mediar conflitos. Dá orientações a visitantes, fornecedores e prestadores de serviços conforme as normas internas. Atua em conjunto com outros profissionais de segurança em ações mais complexas. O cargo exige atenção constante, responsabilidade, boa comunicação, tomada de decisão rápida e residência preferencial na Zona Oeste ou Centro.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

Formação: Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório). Diferenciais: Cursos complementares na área de segurança. Experiência: De 6 meses a 1 ano em funções como vigia, porteiro ou controlador de acesso. Atenção aos detalhes e vigilância constante Boa comunicação verbal e escrita Tomada de decisão rápida em situações de risco Disciplina, pontualidade, responsabilidade e ética profissional Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e discrição Resistência física e disposição para turnos noturnos ou longas jornadas em pé Residir preferencialmente na Zona Oeste ou Centro Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos, finais de semana e feriados Conhecimento básico em informática (uso de sistemas de monitoramento, preenchimento de relatórios etc.) BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

Vale Alimentação/Refeição: R$ 25,00 p/dia Vale Transporte Adicional Noturno (em caso de turno da noite) INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

title: Vigia
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

Controla o acesso de pessoas, veículos e mercadorias, verificando documentos e autorizações, impedindo a entrada de não autorizados. Informando superiores sobre qualquer anormalidade ou risco. Responsável por monitorar as imagens do sistema de CFTV para identificar situações suspeitas ou anormais. Realiza rondas periódicas nas áreas internas e externas da empresa, prevenindo furtos, vandalismos e outras irregularidades.

Identifica e age preventivamente diante de riscos de acidentes ou situações que comprometam a segurança. Em emergências (como incêndios, invasões ou acidentes), aciona os serviços competentes e atua para minimizar danos, podendo também mediar conflitos. Dá orientações a visitantes, fornecedores e prestadores de serviços conforme as normas internas. Atua em conjunto com outros profissionais de segurança em ações mais complexas. O cargo exige atenção constante, responsabilidade, boa comunicação, tomada de decisão rápida e residência preferencial na Zona Oeste ou Centro.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

Formação: Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório). Diferenciais: Cursos complementares na área de segurança. Experiência: De 6 meses a 1 ano em funções como vigia, porteiro ou controlador de acesso. Atenção aos detalhes e vigilância constante Boa comunicação verbal e escrita Tomada de decisão rápida em situações de risco Disciplina, pontualidade, responsabilidade e ética profissional Capacidade de trabalho em equipe e discrição Resistência física e disposição para turnos noturnos ou longas jornadas em pé Residir preferencialmente na Zona Oeste ou Centro Disponibilidade para atuar em turnos, finais de semana e feriados Conhecimento básico em informática (uso de sistemas de monitoramento, preenchimento de relatórios etc.) BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

Vale Alimentação/Refeição: R$ 25,00 p/dia Vale Transporte Adicional Noturno (em caso de turno da noite) INFORMAÇÕES ADICIONAIS

title: Supervisor de Área
description:
DESCRIÇÃO DA VAGA

É responsável por visitar os postos conforme a rota definida, verificando a presença, postura, uniforme e equipamentos dos vigilantes, assegurando o cumprimento das normas operacionais estabelecidas. Também acompanha as escalas de trabalho, confirma a presença dos profissionais nos turnos e providencia coberturas em casos de faltas ou atrasos, realizando os devidos ajustes conforme as necessidades operacionais.

Entre suas atribuições está a aplicação de treinamentos práticos e rápidos no próprio local de trabalho (on-the-job), com foco na correção de falhas e reforço dos procedimentos de segurança. Além disso, é responsável por preencher checklists operacionais, relatar ocorrências, irregularidades e comunicar qualquer anormalidade à central ou à gerência.

Realiza vistorias nos equipamentos utilizados pelos vigilantes, como rádios comunicadores, lanternas, sistemas de CFTV e alarmes, garantindo que todos estejam funcionando corretamente e que os profissionais estejam com os EPIs e materiais exigidos para a função.

Durante ocorrências, o supervisor presta apoio direto à equipe, atuando em casos como invasões, furtos ou acidentes, acionando as autoridades competentes quando necessário e registrando os fatos de forma clara e precisa.
Mantém contato frequente com os responsáveis nos locais de vigilância, avaliando a satisfação do cliente em relação aos serviços prestados e repassando os feedbacks à gestão. Além disso, realiza inspeções surpresa para verificar a conduta dos vigilantes, o cumprimento de horários e a execução correta das rotinas nos postos.

REQUISITOS DA VAGA

Formação:Ensino Médio completo (obrigatório). Curso de Formação de Vigilante (obrigatório). Curso de Supervisão de Segurança (desejável). Ensino Superior em Gestão de Segurança Privada, Administração ou áreas correlatas (desejável). Certificado de Curso de Vigilante atualizado, conforme Portaria da Polícia Federal. Habilitação: CNH Categoria A/B (obrigatória o supervisor pode atuar com moto ou carro). Experiência comprovada como vigilante. Mínimo de 1 ano de experiência como líder de equipe, inspetor ou supervisor de segurança. Vivência com rondas operacionais e atendimento ao cliente será considerado um diferencial. Roteirização e controle de visitas a postos. Técnicas de supervisão, liderança e abordagem de equipe. Noções de vigilância patrimonial e segurança eletrônica. Uso de aplicativos para controle de ponto, checklists e elaboração de relatórios. Informática básica: Word, Excel e demais ferramentas do pacote Office. Análise de ocorrências e tomada de decisão rápida em situações adversas. Liderança e postura profissional. Boa comunicação oral e escrita. Capacidade de resolver conflitos. Organização, disciplina e comprometimento com horários e rotas. Resistência à pressão e a imprevistos. BENEFÍCIOS DA VAGA

title: Director of Finance, Real Estate and Capital Asset Development
description:
Overview

Director of Finance, Real Estate and Capital Asset Development

Be among the first 25 applicants. Get AI-powered advice on this job and more exclusive features.

The Talent Acquisition department hires qualified candidates to fill positions which contribute to the overall strategic success of Howard University. Hiring staff “for fit” makes significant contributions to Howard University’s overall mission. At Howard University, we prioritize well-being and professional growth.

What We Offer
  • Health & Wellness: Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision insurance, plus mental health support
  • Work-Life Balance: PTO, paid holidays, flexible work arrangements
  • Financial Wellness: Competitive salary, 403(b) with company match
  • Professional Development: Ongoing training, tuition reimbursement, and career advancement paths
  • Additional Perks: Wellness programs, commuter benefits, and a vibrant company culture

Join Howard University and thrive with us!

Basic Function

The Director of Real Estate Finance plays a pivotal leadership role in the financial planning, investment strategy, and execution of complex real estate transactions within the Real Estate Development and Capital Asset Management (REDCAM) portfolio. Reporting to the Vice President and Chief Real Estate Officer, this role is responsible for guiding financial strategy for student housing, commercial development, acquisitions, ground leases, and joint ventures in support of the University’s strategic mission.

This position requires advanced financial acumen, a deep understanding of institutional real estate, and the ability to lead through highly complex development initiatives in alignment with the University’s strategic plan and the approved Campus Master Plan. The Director oversees financial analysis, long range capital planning, transaction structuring, and performance monitoring to ensure the portfolio supports institutional goals, adheres to risk parameters, and maintains financial sustainability. Additionally, the Director must create and support an environment that fosters teamwork, leadership development, integrity, and service responsiveness, while effectively managing relationships with business partners, regulatory agencies, and internal and external stakeholders.

Supervisory Accountability

The incumbent is responsible for overseeing the successful completion of projects, and is therefore expected to ensure all contributing parties remain on task, on time, and on budget. While this position does not have formal direct reports, the Director leads cross-functional deal teams composed of analysts, external advisors, consultants, and university stakeholders.

Nature And Scope

Internal contacts include executives, administrators, faculty, students, and staff of the university at large.

External contacts include housing partners, investors and lenders, consultants, contractors, local regulatory agencies, historical societies, local surrounding communities, representatives from other colleges and universities, visitors, and the general public.

Principal AccountabilitiesFinancial Analysis and Reporting
  • Conduct comprehensive financial analyses and prepare reports to assess key performance indicators and operational efficiencies.
Strategic Financial Planning
  • Long-term financial planning for the University’s real estate portfolio that anticipates and responds to legislative changes affecting higher education specifically. Develop scenario based financial models and sensitivity analysis in coordination with the Office of Data Analytics and External Affairs that incorporate potential regulatory changes, mitigate risk, and capitalize on new opportunities.
Budgeting And Forecasting
  • Support the budgeting process, implementing financial models for accurate forecasting.
Investment And Strategic Planning And Analysis
  • Support pre-transaction analysis and due diligence, including financial modeling and pro forma analysis, cost-benefit or return on investment analysis, feasibility analysis, market research, and review of third party reports such as market demand studies, environmental assessments, appraisals, facility assessment reports, among others.
  • Evaluate new investment opportunities and support the development of strategies for long-term needs and uses of the University’s real property assets including acquisitions, development, leasing, and disposition of assets.
  • Review all real estate agreements, documents, and contracts working with the Office of General Counsel to ensure compliance with the university strategic plans and procedures, and compliance with pertinent District of Columbia and Maryland laws, as applicable.
Project Support
  • Provide financial guidance to enhance property management financial efficiency and cost control. Provides support for a portfolio of real estate projects, entailing development, construction, property management, legal, and financial components.
Stakeholder Communication
  • Prepare and clearly communicate transaction analysis, financial data and strategies to university stakeholders, regarding structure, economics, mission benefits, progress, etc.
Academic Collaboration
  • Works collaboratively with the offices of the Chief Financial Officer and other members of the Administrative Services Leadership Team.
Presentation Support
  • Support the preparation of RFQ/RFP responses for all bids, ensuring compliance to policy and procedure, including zoning laws and securing public approval.
  • Preparation of materials and presentations for the Facilities and Real Estate Committee and the Board of Trustees.
Administrative Support
  • Provide administrative support as needed, including contract review and revision in coordination with outside counsel, and tracking and managing project budgets. Oversee these functions through to completion, ensuring compliance with all University processes and procedures.

Perform other related duties as assigned.

Core CompetenciesAnalytical and Strategic Thinking
  • Ability to perform complex financial underwriting, and conduct complex structuring including joint ventures, development, and debt instruments.
  • Knowledge of underwriting and closing debt and equity transactions locally, regionally, and nationally.
  • Must possess advanced analytical skills in evaluating real estate transactions.
  • Ability to gather and thoroughly analyze information in order to make well-founded recommendations to the University’s Senior Administration.
Communication, Organizational, And Interpersonal Skills
  • Demonstrate the ability to use sound judgment and to be an effective decision maker.
  • Ability to convey complex financial information clearly and build strong relationships with university and external stakeholders.
  • Strong attention to detail, and the ability to independently manage a transaction pipeline.
  • Excellent interpersonal, written, verbal, and analytical skills.
  • Ability to establish and maintain harmonious work relationships with students, staff, faculty, University officials, and the general public.
  • Ability to develop knowledge of, respect for, and skills to engage with those of other cultures or backgrounds is required.
Innovation And Problem-Solving
  • Creative approach to improving financial performance and operational processes.
  • Demonstrated ability to multi-task; to be a team player; and to be flexible and adaptable to change.
Technology Proficiency
  • Proven strength in the use of spreadsheets, database, and presentation applications, including Microsoft Excel and PowerPoint. Demonstrated proficiency in financial modeling and analysis tools.
Minimum Requirements
  • Bachelor’s Degree in Finance, Real Estate, Economics, or related field
  • MBA with a concentration in Finance, Real Estate, or related field
  • Minimum 12-15 years of related work experience, including real estate focused banking, development, finance, underwriting, structured finance, fundamental credit analysis, consulting, urban planning, and/or public policy; including experience with institutional or public-sector projects.
  • CFA or CAIA candidate status is strongly preferred.
  • 15 years of related work experience may be substituted in lieu of educational qualifications.
  • Strong analytical, financial modeling, and reporting skills.
  • Excellent communication, leadership, and project management abilities.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite and financial software.

Overview

The Company You’ll Join Carta connects founders, investors, and limited partners through world-class software, purpose-built for everyone in venture capital, private equity and private credit. Trusted by 65,000+ companies in 160+ countries, Carta’s platform of software and services lays the groundwork so you can build, invest, and scale with confidence. Carta’s Fund Administration platform supports 9,000+ funds and SPVs, representing nearly $185B in assets under management, with tools designed to enhance the strategic impact of fund CFOs. Recognized by Fortune, Forbes, Fast Company, Inc. and Great Places to Work, Carta is shaping the future of private market infrastructure. Together, Carta is creating the end-to-end ERP platform for private markets. Traditional ERP solutions don’t work for Private Funds. Private capital markets need a comprehensive software solution to replace outdated spreadsheets and fragmented service providers. Carta’s software for the Office of the Fund CFO does just that - it’s a new category of software to make private markets look more like public markets - a connected ERP for private capital. For more information about our offices and culture, check out our Carta careers page.

The Problems You\'ll Solve

As we continue expanding beyond Venture Capital into Private Equity markets, we’re building solutions to address the unique challenges of clients managing companies and funds structured as LLCs. These entities vary widely in contractual structures and represent diverse asset classes, requiring a flexible and scalable data model that supports distinct product experiences. Additionally, Private Equity firms, their investors, legal partners, and portfolio companies interact with our platform through different user personas and permissions, making robust access control and tailored experiences essential.

As a Senior Engineer on this team, you’ll play a critical role in shaping the next generation of ownership management products. You’ll work closely with product, design, and go-to-market teams—as well as directly with top-tier Private Equity firms and enterprise-scale clients—to deeply understand their needs and deliver high-quality technical solutions.

The Team You\'ll Work With

You’ll be joining our Asset Management LLC Captable team. We launched the Carta LLC product in 2020 and, after discovering a repeatable go-to-market motion, have been on a journey to scale it across the entire portfolio of Private Equity companies. We’re also expanding to support a wide range of ownership management workflows. The scope and impact of each individual on the team are immense. We are biased toward action and believe in the mantra: build → measure → learn. As part of our team, you\'ll work closely with product managers and designers to understand the motivation (why) behind a customer need, define the scope of work (what), and collaborate with your engineering peers to build solutions (how) that deliver meaningful customer value.

About You

You deeply care about your user and are relentless in your pursuit to build delightful user experiences that wow the customer! You are energized by solving deep problems collaboratively who can easily transition between a Solver and Tech Lead archetype. Additionally,

  • You have 5+ years of full-stack or backend engineering experience.
  • You are passionate about some elements of our tech stack (ReactJS, Java, Datadog, REST / GRPC, Kafka, K8s, AWS)
  • You are excited to work with stakeholders across engineering, product, business and marketing.
  • You have a desire to become a product domain expert and refine ambiguous product requirements to deliver customer value.
  • You see communication as one of your strengths.
  • You want to build and own your work end-to-end.
  • You are eager to move fast, but recognize when to build for the future.
The Interview Process

Carta follows a standard tech startup interview process, where you will meet with a recruiter and hiring manager first. We’ll then ask you to show off your skills with a real-world take home exercise (we do not do LeetCode-style interviews, no one will quiz you on writing a doubly-linked list) and virtual interviews. During the process, you can ask questions to people across different parts of the Fund Administration team to learn what kind of work we do and how it lines up with your interests.

Overview

Staff Application Security Engineers, Ledn is interested in hearing from you!

Ledn is a global financial services company built for digital assets, helping to improve the everyday lives of Bitcoin holders while building generational wealth for the future. We offer a suite of egalitarian lending, savings and trading products to digital asset holders in over 150 countries around the world. Through our products & services, we can make a difference in the lives and futures of our clients - in real terms. Our team at Ledn is a passionate group of individuals from diverse backgrounds. What we all have in common is an unshakeable conviction that digital assets can democratize access to the global economy and Ledn's suite of products & services can play a critical role in doing so. The core values that guide us are: act with integrity always, own it, have a passion for progress, and lead with empathy. Combining these values with our conviction make Ledn an unstoppable force in changing the world for the better. Come join us as we build, innovate and revolutionize financial services!

The Opportunity

We are seeking a full time Staff Application Security Engineer with deep expertise in Application Security, Identity & Access Management, and Confidential Computing to strengthen the security of our Bitcoin-backed loan platform. Security is fundamental to protecting our customers and business, and this role will drive both the tactical improvements and long-term strategy for securing our applications and authentication systems. You will work across our JavaScript/TypeScript services, AWS serverless stack (Lambda, API Gateway, Cognito, SNS, SQS), MongoDB and Kubernetes microservices, and take ownership of evolving our authentication layer toward modern, phishing-resistant approaches. In addition, you will design and operate AWS Nitro Enclaves to protect critical data and cryptographic operations in isolated, verifiable environments. This is a hands-on engineering role with direct impact on product security, infrastructure security, and customer trust.

Responsibilities
  • Application Security: Lead secure design and code reviews across engineering teams. Define and enforce secure coding practices for JavaScript/TypeScript services. Automate vulnerability detection (SAST, SCA, DAST) within CI/CD. Conduct threat modeling and risk assessments for new features. Partner with engineers to remediate vulnerabilities and improve secure development practices.
  • Authentication & Identity: Own the roadmap for authentication and identity across customer and internal applications. Enhance existing Cognito-based identity architecture with stronger, phishing-resistant MFA solutions (e.g., WebAuthn, passkeys, hardware tokens). Collaborate with Product to align usability, compliance, and security in authentication flows. Define secure approaches to session management, device trust, and account recovery.
  • Confidential Computing (AWS Nitro Enclaves): Design enclave-based architectures to isolate and protect sensitive workloads. Integrate Nitro Enclaves with KMS and secure APIs. Migrate high-value operations (e.g., cryptographic and financial processes) into enclave environments. Ensure compliance, auditability, and resilience of enclave workloads.
  • Additional Security Domains: Harden AWS services (Lambda, API Gateway, SQS, SNS) with least-privilege IAM and secure key management. Improve Kubernetes security posture (RBAC, pod security, image scanning, runtime monitoring). Deploy and operate a SIEM framework; develop detection rules, dashboards, and incident playbooks. Support compliance initiatives (SOC 2, ISO 27001) with security controls and documentation.
What You Bring To Ledn
  • 10 years minimum of proven experience in Application Security with a focus on web and cloud-native applications.
  • Strong knowledge of JavaScript/TypeScript/Golang/Python and modern web vulnerabilities (OWASP Top 10, auth bypasses, business logic flaws).
  • Expertise with AWS security best practices, particularly in serverless architectures.
  • Hands-on experience with AWS Nitro Enclaves for confidential computing.
  • Deep understanding of authentication and authorization standards (OAuth2, OIDC, WebAuthn, FIDO2).
  • Practical experience with Cognito / Auth0 (MFA, custom flows, secure session handling).
  • Background in SIEM design and log correlation across cloud and application layers.
  • Familiarity with Kubernetes security (RBAC, pod security, admission controls, image scanning).
  • Experience with Secure Code Review. Understanding of software supply chain. Deep understanding of Linux internals. Remediate vulnerabilities identified in the penetration test report.
  • Strong communication and collaboration skills, able to influence engineering and product teams.
Nice To Haves
  • Familiarity with Bitcoin custody and key management practices.
  • Knowledge of Infrastructure as Code security (Terraform, AWS CDK).
  • Prior work on user-facing security features such as passwordless authentication, recovery flows, or device trust.
Culture Fit

We\'re looking for more than just operational excellence — we want a leader who thrives in the startup or tech environment and embodies our values.

The Ideal Candidate Will
  • Have a passion for progress by being adaptable and resilient, and is comfortable navigating ambiguity in a high-growth, fast-paced environment.
  • Have a builder\'s mindset, excited to create, iterate, and scale IS practices.
  • Be a collaborative partner, able to influence across functions and cultures with empathy and clarity.
  • Demonstrate integrity and accountability, especially in managing confidential information across diverse legal and cultural contexts.
  • Have worked in a remote environment before.
A Taste Of What We Provide
  • As one of the world\'s leading digital asset companies, we provide tremendous growth opportunities.
  • Comprehensive, best-in-class total rewards package that starts on your first day.
  • We offer a competitive PTO package that ensures you have the time off you deserve.
  • Ownership in the company via shared equity for Ledn employees.
  • Remote work flexibility up to 180 days per year (subject to restrictions).
  • A career that provides you with purpose in your job and a working environment free of barriers.
  • We are an equal opportunity employment organization and pride ourselves on inclusivity, diversity, and the success that comes from diversity.

You may reach out to the Ledn team for accommodation requests throughout all stages of the recruitment process. Requests will be addressed confidentially.

description:
Overview

Cint is a pioneer in research technology (ResTech). Our customers use the Cint platform to post questions and get answers from real people to build business strategies, confidently publish research, accurately measure the impact of digital advertising, and more. The Cint platform is built on a programmatic marketplace, which is the world’s largest, with nearly 300 million respondents in over 150 countries who consent to sharing their opinions, motivations, and behaviours. We are feeding the world’s curiosity!

The Opportunity

Cint is looking to raise the bar on engineering standards as well as user experiences. We offer a smaller company atmosphere, where engineers can shape technical strategy, lead cross-team initiatives, and set the direction for how we build and deliver products at scale. Our products are redefining experiences within the industry—join us to help define the future of our platform while multiplying the impact of the teams around you.

We’re seeking a Staff Frontend Engineer to join our UI Engineering team. This team focuses on providing frontend solutions to multiple projects and tooling to the whole company. We are deeply committed to advancing our frontend architecture (Next.js), ensuring alignment with our Design Systems, and collaborating with backend teams to deliver consistent, reliable, and user-friendly experiences across the platform.

What You Will Do

As a Staff Frontend Engineer, you will join our globally distributed team to shape and elevate Cint’s Measurement, Survey Platform, and Design System experiences. Your mission is to craft high-quality, scalable user interfaces that power our core research products and deliver intuitive experiences for our customers while enabling internal teams to move faster with confidence.

You will be a product-oriented and platform UI engineer, taking full ownership of the end-to-user experience. This includes partnering closely with UX designers, product managers, and fellow engineers to understand customer and stakeholder needs for both external user-facing products and internal products like our survey platform and design systems.

Responsibilities
  • Partner closely with Product Managers and UX designers to deliver polished, user-centric experiences and support product rollouts.
  • Create scalable and maintainable frontend components, while enhancing and extending our shared Design System.
  • Monitor and optimize application performance, resolving bottlenecks proactively.
  • Lead cross-team technical initiatives, set architectural direction, and ensure alignment on frontend strategy across the organization.
  • Proactively shape engineering practices, propose improvements, and influence standards adopted by multiple teams.
  • Advocate for and document best practices in frontend development.
  • Own and architect systems or product areas end-to-end, designing solutions that scale across multiple teams and business domains.
  • Build strong cross-functional relationships to ensure smooth collaboration and alignment.
  • Write clean, modular, and maintainable code that stands the test of time.
  • Continuously improve and refactor existing codebases for reliability and efficiency.
  • Take responsibility for production systems through on-call rotations, ensuring stability and fast incident resolution.
  • Mentor and sponsor engineers at all levels, building future technical leaders and spreading best practices throughout the company.
  • Anticipate organizational and architectural challenges, define long-term strategies, and drive adoption of solutions that improve scalability, reliability, and developer experience across Cint.
QualificationsWhat We Are Looking For
  • 7+ years of software engineering experience, including significant time driving cross-team technical initiatives and architectural decisions.
  • Highly proficient in Next.js 14+ (App Router), including expertise in data caching strategies and performance optimization.
  • Proficient in UI rendering architectures (SSR, CSR, SSG, ISR) and the ability to determine their appropriate application.
  • Expertise in designing and implementing robust UI solutions using TypeScript, with a strong focus on comprehensive typing across the stack.
  • Experience breaking down product documents into feature epics and user stories, driving features from concept to reality promptly.
  • Experience with CSS and Tailwind, and working with Figma and internal design systems.
  • Track record of building reliable, performant systems and establishing testing and quality practices adopted across teams.
  • Strong communication skills, capable of articulating complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.
  • Ability to define and drive technical standards across multiple teams or product lines, aligning stakeholders and ensuring adoption.

  • Experience testing complex widget/component‑based systems.

  • Understanding of configurable and modular test environments.
  • Working knowledge of Agile/Scrum methodologies and cross‑functional teams.

description:
Job Description

Fugro’s innovation teams are responsible for carrying out developments serving both internal users and Fugro clients. With Innovation centers in Canada, Brazil, USA, and other key locations around the world; you will be joining a global innovation group with a tradition of developing best-of-class applications in the Geo-data space. Our engineers are experts in domains such as spatial data, cloud computing, deep learning, and process automation.

As a Test Automation Engineer at Fugro, you will play a key role in ensuring the seamless functionality and performance of our web-based data processing pipelines. Collaborate with cross-functional teams to design, implement, and execute automated test scenarios, contributing to the delivery of a high-quality product.

What You Will Do
  • Design and implement automated test scripts for web-based data applications.
  • Collaborate with designers, developers, and QA team members to understand application features and design effective test strategies.
  • Execute automated tests, analyze results, and report on test status, contributing to the overall quality assurance process.
  • Identify, document, and track software defects, working closely with development teams to facilitate resolution.
  • Contribute to the continuous improvement of testing processes and methodologies at Fugro.
  • Stay abreast of industry trends and best practices in test automation.

Please submit your resume/CV in English

What We Are Looking For
  • 3+ years of experience as a Test Automation Engineer
  • Proficiency in automation testing tools and frameworks, such as Playwright, Selenium, or similar.
  • Strong programming skills in languages like C#, Python, or JavaScript.
  • Experience with API testing and integration testing.
  • Solid understanding of database concepts and SQL
  • Familiarity with Agile development methodologies.
  • Excellent problem-solving and analytical skills.
  • At least Upper-Intermediate level of spoken and written English.
Bonus Points
  • Experience with performance testing tools
  • Knowledge of CI/CD pipelines and integration with test automation.
  • Familiarity with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS).
  • Previous experience working with geospatial data.
How We Work

At Fugro, we believe in alignment, autonomy, and personal accountability throughout the product life cycle. Our collaborative work environment blends the flexibility of remote work with in-office collaboration, fostering a culture built on trust.

About Fugro

Fugro is the world's leading independent provider of geo-intelligence and asset integrity solutions for large construction, infrastructure, and natural resources. We collect and analyze data about the Earth and the structures built upon it, providing comprehensive information and advice to our clients to help them make better decisions about their assets and projects. We rely on innovation to push the transition towards net-zero carbon, safe infrastructure and climate resilience to deliver on our promise to create a safe and livable world.

Why would you join us?

International Geo-data environment – We work for and with the entire world. The Earth is fascinating, as are the people on it. We work hard to create and maintain an inclusive culture. Challenging projects and exciting opportunities – We are ahead of the curve and have the best projects to work on. In addition, exciting opportunities arise around the world every day. Freedom to grow faster – If you are prepared to take the initiative, ample opportunities locally or worldwide await you at Fugro.

A infraestrutura do Hospital conta com dez andares, nos quais estão distribuídos os serviços de emergência e de Unidade de Tratamento Intensivo (UTI) adulta, pediátrica e neonatal; maternidade; clínica médica, cirurgia-geral e bucomaxilofacial, neurocirurgia, psiquiatria, pediatria e ortopedia. Como é o processo seletivo na PRIO?

Gostamos de já chegar na entrevista te conhecendo um pouco, então pedimos a você que preencha ainda na etapa de cadastro alguns testes para podermos avaliar o seu Match com a nossa Cultura :)

Depois, nós do time de RH vamos marcar um papo com você. A ideia é aprofundar um pouco mais nas suas experiências, buscando o alinhamento com o perfil da vaga e comportamental que buscamos para a PRIO. Também vamos falar sobre a companhia, fluxo do processo, benefícios e tirar suas dúvidas!

Dica: Nesse nosso papo, vamos querer saber sobre experiências que você já vivenciou, alinhadas aos valores da PRIO. A ideia é que você possa nos apresentar essas vivências de forma completa, com contextos, sua responsabilidade, o que você fez e qual foi o resultado.

Em seguida, vamos adentrando em aspectos mais técnicos, que podem envolver um case ou apenas uma entrevista com o(a) gestor(a) da vaga, para conhecer os desafios técnicos da vaga e será avaliado dentro dos requisitos da vaga.

Ao fim, os finalistas conversam com o diretor da respectiva área para a escolha final!

Como se preparar para o processo seletivo na PRIO:

  • Pesquise sobre o negócio da companhia e nossa atuação no setor de óleo e gás;
  • Busque se atualizar sobre as notícias recentes da companhia, sejam da imprensa ou divulgadas em nosso site de relações com investidores;
  • Acesses nossas redes sociais para conhecer mais sobre como é trabalhar na PRIO!
  • Pense na sua história e principais realizações. Estruture seus resultados e conquistas para relatá-los na hora da entrevista.

Fale dos sucessos, mas entender as falhas e como você aprendeu com elas também é importante. Prezamos pela transparência, por isso, não tenha medo de falar sobre os seus insucessos.

Desejamos a você um bom processo seletivo! Venha fazer parte da PRIO

Acreditamos na condução dos negócios, com foco em segurança e cuidado com a saúde dos seus colaboradores.

Nossos ambiente de trabalho

Oferecemos um ambiente de trabalho dinâmico e com muitas oportunidades de participação em diferentes projetos, favorecendo o desenvolvimento profissional e o crescimento do time. Trabalhamos em um escritório open space, o que permite a integração entre todas as equipes e a Diretoria, onde todos podem participar da tomada de decisões. title: System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking
description:
System Software Engineer - Ubuntu Networking

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is very widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors.

We are hiring a System Software Engineer for Ubuntu Networking to focus on the connectivity of Ubuntu in a wide range of circumstances, from cloud to server to desktop and IoT. We would like to strengthen the tooling, services, documentation, robustness, security and clarity of Linux network abstractions to provide fast, reliable and secure connections for Ubuntu.

The network stack is one of the most critical aspects of any operating system where stability, reliability and uptime are paramount. Its ease of use and reliability contribute to Ubuntu's success from IoT, Desktop, Server to the Cloud. We are expanding our Foundations team to focus our efforts on this essential function and are looking for people passionate about lower level technologies involved in an operating system's network stack.

As a Linux System Engineer, you will maintain and integrate core components involved in the network stack of the Ubuntu Distribution. You will be discussing design with other team members, upstream projects, mentor less senior engineers and participate in code reviews and design reviews. You will also be working with other teams to ensure architecture decisions improve the overall performance and experience of Ubuntu.

Location: This role will be based remotely in the AMERICAS region

The role entails

  • Collaborate proactively with a distributed team
  • Shape software-define networking products for evolving data center architectures to meet ever-increasing bandwidth, reliability, security, and interoperability demands
  • Write high-quality, well-designed and well-documented software
  • Debug issues and produce high-quality code to fix them
  • Collaborate proactively with a globally distributed organization
  • Contribute to technical documentation to make it the best of its kind
  • Display technical leadership internally, towards our partners, and in the open source communities
  • Influence open-source projects and communities
  • Shape innovative product strategies
  • Work from home with global travel 2 to 4 weeks a year for internal and external events

What we are looking for in you

  • Deep understanding and passion for Linux networking, from kernel to user space
  • Professional experience with computer networks, including virtual networks, distributed systems as well as understanding of hardware offloading technologies.
  • Interest in systemd-networkd, NetworkManager, ModemManager, iwd, conman, bluez, iproute2, Open vSwitch, WireGuard and similar software components
  • Fluency in at least one of Golang, C/C++, Rust or Python
  • Experience with Linux (Debian or Ubuntu preferred)
  • Interest in packaging software for Debian and Ubuntu
  • Exceptional academic track record from both high school and university
  • Undergraduate degree in a technical subject or a compelling narrative about your alternative chosen path
  • You love technology and working with brilliant people
  • You are passionate, curious, flexible, articulate, and accountable
  • You value soft skills and are passionate, enterprising, thoughtful, and self-motivated
  • Ability to travel internationally twice a year for company events up to two weeks long

What we offer colleagues

  • Distributed work environment with twice-yearly team sprints in person
  • Personal learning and development budget of USD 2,000 per year
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Maternity and paternity leave
  • Team Member Assistance Program & Wellness Platform
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues
  • Priority Pass and travel upgrades for long-haul company events

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer. We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

title: Engineering Manager - App Stores
description:
Overview

Canonical is a leading provider of open source software and operating systems to the global enterprise and technology markets. Our platform, Ubuntu, is widely used in breakthrough enterprise initiatives such as public cloud, data science, AI, engineering innovation, and IoT. Our customers include the world's leading public cloud and silicon providers, and industry leaders in many sectors. The company is a pioneer of global distributed collaboration, with 1200+ colleagues in 75+ countries and very few office-based roles. Teams meet two to four times yearly in person, in interesting locations around the world, to align on strategy and execution. The company is founder-led, profitable, and growing.

This is a technical management role to lead a team that develops Python and Golang micro-services that power our global software distribution engine. The world sees it as the Snap Store and Charmhub.io marketplaces; behind the scenes it is a unified system that understands key concepts in software distribution - architectures, releases, betas, release candidates, stable releases, branches and more. We are on a journey to transform the experience that people all over the world have with their open source software by significantly expanding the range of software we can deliver through this system. If you have a passion for clean APIs, believe that great engineers ship software calmly and regularly against an agile plan, and know that tests are the key to higher velocity and reliability, you\'ll fit right in.

This is a great opportunity to take part in engineering a highly scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical\'s world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

As an Engineering Manager at Canonical, you must be technically strong, but your main responsibility is to run an effective team and develop the colleagues you manage. You will develop and review code as a leader, but know that the best way to improve the product is to ensure that the whole team is focused, productive and unblocked. You are expected to help them grow as engineers, do meaningful work, do it outstandingly well, find professional and personal satisfaction, and work well with colleagues and the community. You will also be expected to be a positive influence on culture, facilitate technical delivery, and regularly reflect with your team on strategy and execution. You will collaborate closely with other Engineering Managers, product managers, and architects, producing an engineering roadmap with ambitious and achievable goals.

We expect Engineering Managers to be fluent in the programming language, architecture, and components that their team uses. Code reviews and architectural leadership are part of the job. The commitment to healthy engineering practices, documentation, quality and performance optimisation is as important, as is the requirement for fair and clear management, and the obligation to ensure a high-performing team.

This is a great opportunity to really learn how to do engineering of a highly-scalable SaaS product (think about the load on our systems when one of our largest Ubuntu Desktop snaps is updated by the publisher). In addition, you will have the opportunity to learn from Canonical\'s world-class security team as we work collectively to deliver this capability, safely, to our customers around the world.

Location : This role may be based remotely in the Americas, Europe, Middle East or Africa time zones.

What your day will look like
  • Lead a remote team of engineers in your time zone
  • Develop talent through coaching, mentoring, feedback, and hands-on career development
  • Set and manage expectations with other engineering teams, management, and external stakeholders
  • Be an active part of the leadership team and collaborate with other leaders in the organisation
  • With your team, build clean web service APIs to support both CLI and web frontend clients, using Python (and optionally Golang).
  • Engage with many other teams at Canonical, as well as the open-source community and commercial partners
What we are looking for in you
  • Good experience in leading modern, agile software development practices
  • Experience in forming a healthy, collaborative engineering culture in line with the company values
  • Demonstrative experience of being a role model for sound engineering principles and directly contributing toward your team\'s goals
  • Willingness to travel up to 4 times a year for internal events
  • You love to mentor, develop and grow people, and have a track record of doing it
  • You are knowledgeable and passionate about software development
  • You are focused on success and the timely delivery of high-quality software
  • You value and nurture great team culture and spirit
  • You have experience and commitment to agile development methodologies
  • Software development experience in Python (experience in Golang in addition to that would be a big plus)
  • Effective written and verbal communication skills
  • Practical experience with Linux system administration
What we offer you

Your base pay will depend on various factors including your geographical location, level of experience, knowledge and skills. In addition to the benefits above, certain roles are also eligible for additional benefits and rewards including annual bonuses and sales incentives based on revenue or utilisation. Our compensation philosophy is to ensure equity right across our global workforce.

In addition to a competitive base pay, we provide all team members with additional benefits, which reflect our values and ideals. Please note that additional benefits may apply depending on the work location and, for more information on these, you can ask in the later stages of the recruitment process.

  • Fully remote working environment - we\'ve been working remotely since 2004!
  • Personal learning and development budget of 2,000 USD per annum
  • Annual compensation review
  • Recognition rewards
  • Annual holiday leave
  • Parental leave
  • Employee Assistance Programme
  • Opportunity to travel to new locations to meet colleagues at \"sprints\"
  • Priority Pass for travel and travel upgrades for long haul company events
About Canonical

Canonical is a pioneering tech firm at the forefront of the global move to open source. As the company that publishes Ubuntu, one of the most important open-source projects and the platform for AI, IoT, and the cloud, we are changing the world of software. We recruit on a global basis and set a very high standard for people joining the company. We expect excellence; in order to succeed, we need to be the best at what we do. Most colleagues at Canonical have worked from home since our inception in 2004. Working here is a step into the future and will challenge you to think differently, work smarter, learn new skills, and raise your game.

Canonical is an equal opportunity employer

We are proud to foster a workplace free from discrimination. Diversity of experience, perspectives, and background create a better work environment and better products. Whatever your identity, we will give your application fair consideration.

Supervisor de Engenharia Clínica

O Técnico de Engenharia Clínica é o profissional técnico responsável por assegurar o funcionamento contínuo, seguro e eficaz do parque tecnológico de equipamentos médico-hospitalares. Ele executa manutenções preventivas, corretivas, calibrações e ensaios, garantindo a disponibilidade dos equipamentos para o atendimento ao paciente, em conformidade com as normas técnicas e os procedimentos internos. Sua atuação é fundamental para a segurança do paciente e a eficiência operacional da instituição de saúde.

  • Execução de Manutenções e Intervenções Técnicas: Realizar manutenções corretivas nos equipamentos médico-hospitalares, desde a abertura do chamado até a identificação da falha e a intervenção técnica, visando restaurar todas as funcionalidades e retomar a operação de forma segura. Executar manutenções planejadas/programadas (preventivas e preditivas), utilizando padrões e simuladores adequados, para garantir que os equipamentos estejam sempre aptos para uso seguro, com laudos e certificados válidos. Realizar calibrações e ensaios de segurança elétrica nos equipamentos, seguindo os procedimentos e normas técnicas aplicáveis, para assegurar a precisão e a segurança dos dispositivos.
  • Gestão de Equipamentos e Controle Patrimonial: Realizar o controle e rastreio de equipamentos por meio de rondas diárias, verificando o estado geral, a localização e a condição de uso, para garantir sua conservação e disponibilidade. Acompanhar o recebimento de novos equipamentos e insumos, conferindo notas fiscais e a contagem dos produtos, e testando os equipamentos para verificar sua aptidão para o uso. Preservar e zelar pelos equipamentos e ferramentas disponibilizados para sua função, mantendo-os organizados, limpos e conservados, e solicitando novas ferramentas ao supervisor quando necessário, demonstrando cuidado com o patrimônio da empresa.
  • Documentação e Registro no Sistema: Alimentar o sistema de gestão da manutenção (SGM), realizando a abertura de Ordens de Serviço (OS) e preenchendo detalhadamente as ações executadas, peças utilizadas e observações, para garantir um histórico preciso e completo do equipamento. Assegurar a correta emissão de laudos e certificados de acordo com as normativas vigentes, após a execução das manutenções e calibrações.
  • Acompanhamento e Suporte: Manter o supervisor imediato informado sobre o andamento dos trabalhos e os desafios encontrados, buscando soluções e alinhando as atividades diariamente. Acompanhar as atividades de serviços realizados por terceiros dentro da unidade, por meio da análise de ordens de serviço externas, para garantir o registro e histórico completo dos equipamentos. Executar outras tarefas pertinentes ao cargo que venham a ser delegadas pelo supervisor de engenharia clínica.
  • Relacionamento e Otimização: Realizar cotações de equipamentos e coordenar demonstrações conforme a necessidade do cliente, através do contato com fornecedores, com o objetivo de apoiar a ampliação dos serviços e soluções oferecidas.
